problem: The candidate makes a separate propulsion load case mandatory, but the requirement only requires the ice-milling load sequence to be used for propulsion-line strength evaluation and does not require a second ship-level load-case relationship.
required_change: Remove the mandatory nltl:hasPropulsionLoadCase property constraint and its dependent shape unless an explicit requirement establishes that separate required entity.
regression_guard: Preserve the mandatory ship-to-ice-milling-sequence-case path and its strength-evaluation purpose and stalling-analysis exclusion.
